Qwen3.5-9B, clean one-pick scenes, locker before the pick; n = 151 / 151 (lookup / recall). A cell:
answers switched when one token group takes the changed prompt's state at one layer ('in': the input
token only). Outlined: the bridge word's last layer at ≥ 30%, and the first layer from which it is no
longer read (every layer ≥ l switches ≤ 10%). The whole pick sentence at every layer switches 100% /
